releases.notes:
本次更新的内容有：

- 在原“右白纵向减速线”，“左白导向车道线”和“白纵向减速线“后添加“(白线)”
- 在原“白纵向减速线”和“左白导向车道线”之间添加“右白纵向减速线”，“左白导向车道线”和“白纵向减速线“(最小/小/较小)（添加材质相同的台阶）。
- 添加“折黄线”和“T型黄线”（添加材质相同的台阶）。
- 添加黑，灰，银，蓝，白柱子及其连接地面形式和柱子底座（仅1.16.5及其以上版本）。
- 实现柱子的自动连接（仅1.16.5及其以上版本）。
- 添加了当进入世界时在聊天栏显示mod及版权信息。

修复的bug：

- 修复1.12.2版本在服务端运行时崩溃的bug。（第一个由玩家发现的bug）

本次更新的Minecraft版本：1.12.2，1.16.5，1.17.1。
本次更新为2023年5月的第一次更新。

The contents of this update include:

- Added "(White Line)" behind "White Right Longitudinal Deceleration Line", "White Left Lane-change Lane Line" and "White Longitudinal Deceleration Line"
- Added blocks "White Right Longitudinal Deceleration Line", "White Left Lane-change Lane Line" and "White Longitudinal Deceleration Line"(minimum/small/less) between "White Left Lane-change Lane Line Slab" and original "White Longitudinal Deceleration Line Slab" (Added Slabs with same texture).
- Added "Yellow Right-angle Line" and "Yellow T-shaped Line" (Added Slabs with same texture).
- Added black, gray, silver, blue, white post and its connect ground form and post base (Only 1.16.5 and above version).
- Realize post auto connect (Only 1.16.5 and above version).
- Added mod and copyright information in chat bar when enter the world.

The fixed bug:

- Fixed when 1.12.2 run in the server it will be running failed. (The first bug found by player)

Minecraft Version of this updated: 1.12.2, 1.16.5, 1.17.1.
This updated was the first updated in May 2023.
